events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in 1960s counterculture, began on August 15, 1969, attracting hundreds of thousands to a farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm for '3 Days of Peace & Music'. What was your favourite Woodstock moment, or the one band you wish you'd seen there?

events.title: Elvis Presley anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the "King of Rock and Roll", passed away on August 16, 1977, leaving an indelible mark on music and pop culture.

angles.name: Remembering the King
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to inspire generations. What's the one Elvis track that always gets you?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: Remembering the enduring legacy of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur, who passed away on September 13, 1996, after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's impact
angles.copy: Still a powerful voice in music today. We remember Tupac Shakur and his incredible impact on hip-hop and beyond.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Jimi Hendrix, whose groundbreaking guitar work and electrifying performances continue to resonate decades after his passing on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar legend tribute
angles.copy: The man who redefined the electric guitar. Today, we pay tribute to the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic "Abbey Road" album, featuring timeless tracks and that famous zebra crossing cover, was released on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Iconic album cover
angles.copy: That iconic album cover... and the music inside! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released 57 years ago. What's your top track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today, known for her distinctive voice and enduring rock hits.

angles.name: Pretenders frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and songwriting with The Pretenders have given us so many classics.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a celebrated solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Oasis frontman's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the rock 'n' roll star?

events.title: Imagine single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem "Imagine", a powerful call for peace and unity, was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Lennon's peace anthem
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... living life in peace. John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago in the UK. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: iPod announcement anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, forever changing how we listen to music by putting "1,000 songs in your pocket."

angles.name: Music in your pocket
angles.copy: Remember when the iPod first dropped? 25 years ago, Apple announced the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever. Did you have one?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, "Dr. No", which premiered on October 5, 1962, launching one of cinema's most enduring franchises.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! We're celebrating over 60 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, the iconic co-founder of The Beatles and a legendary solo artist, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and music of John Lennon. His legacy of peace and powerful songs lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy legend's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique humour has brought us so much joy.

events.title: The White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' expansive self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing their diverse musical directions.

angles.name: Beatles' diverse album
angles.copy: The album that proved The Beatles could do anything. 'The White Album' was released 58 years ago. Which track from its incredible 30 songs is your favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away on November 24, 1991, leaving an unparalleled legacy as a performer and vocalist.

angles.name: Queen frontman tribute
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost a true icon. Freddie Mercury's incredible talent and stage presence continue to captivate millions. What's your favourite Queen song?
